tools.name: execute_python
tools.description: Run ordinary persistent Python. np, Fraction, PIL, Image, shapely, cameras, buffers and scratch are available. blender(code,timeout=30) runs ordinary persistent Python in the current Blender. scene_data(selectors=None) reads current raw world geometry. render_views(names,include_images=False,fresh=False) obtains current shared frames. read_images(refs) attaches current images. Printed data are returned. Keep the scene read-only. Use public attributes and current task inputs. Private reflection, administrator/project files, product implementation APIs, external processes and network access are outside this experiment's source boundary. scratch supports ordinary file operations.

tools.name: execute_blender_code
tools.description: Execute ordinary persistent Python in the current read-only Blender. bpy, mathutils and ordinary Python geometry operations are available. Return captured stdout, stderr and any error. Do not move, edit or save the scene.

tools.name: scene_data
tools.description: Read current evaluated raw world vertices and source triangles in original object and triangle order, current source identity, and the six raw camera devices. selectors contains object names. Omit it to read all mesh objects. Source triangle indices are zero-based within each object's returned list.

tools.name: render_views
tools.description: Read or generate current full-frame images with the shared low-level triangle renderer. A source/camera-bound cached frame is reused unless fresh is true. Frame refs are stable. buffers[ref] contains color, depth, owners and triangle_ids. Pixel origin is top-left, indices are zero-based, background owner and triangle ID are -1. Metadata object_names and source_face_offsets map frame owners and global triangle IDs to object names and local source faces. include_images delivers PNG content. This tool returns raw buffers and images.

tools.name: read_images
tools.description: Deliver PNG content for current-session frame refs. It reuses existing images and does not construct a new raster.

scope: ordinary live source and PNG delivery plus common cached reread; independent quality checks original P active before these later checks
